product_contract.service_identity: App roots and UI-test trigger paths consume the runtime projection service installed during launch bootstrap.
product_contract.bootstrap_publication: Mock launch bootstrap returns after app-switcher projection publication; when Accessibility is trusted it also publishes exact fixture window records, Home detail, and a committed Search index.
product_contract.window_identity: Mock window rows use deterministic stable window IDs, deterministic CG IDs, and exact current AX attachment evidence at the testing-support boundary.
product_contract.search_freshness: A pending Search barrier boundedly drains ready repairs created by an earlier repair, commits their main-table evidence, and publishes only a generation-valid index.
product_contract.home_continuity: Home refreshes on committed app-switcher publication and retains the last committed summary and detail during a transient detail-unavailable read.
product_contract.search_entry: A launch-requested Search session remains in the app layer until the committed index is available, then enters the requested Search scope.
product_contract.visible_workflow: Mock and real fixture window titles are discoverable on Home, Switcher, and Search surfaces from the same committed runtime projection candidate.

production_path: FlowTabApp prepares UI-test state before constructing scenes and injects the resolved RuntimeProjectionServing instance into every HomeRootView.

FlowTabUITestBootstrapper installs the mock RuntimeProjectionService, drains app-switcher maintenance, conditionally signals per-app window repairs, then requests and drains the Search freshness barrier.
RuntimeProjectionRepairFactSource asks the UI-test dataset to seed permission-aware WindowRecord main-table evidence.
RuntimeProjectionService drains ready reconciliation requests and, while Search freshness is pending, boundedly drains newly created ready follow-up repairs before committing the Search index.
HomeLandingView refreshes summaries after runtime app-switcher publication and preserves committed UI state while a detail projection is transiently unavailable.
LiveSwitcherModel blocks automatic window-layer entry while Search activation awaits the freshness barrier, then applies the committed Search index notification.
Mock and real fixture UI tests query the visible Search surface produced by the committed projection.

prechange_bootstrap_behavior.signal: Home summary projection and zero-window counts were nil after bootstrap returned.

root_cause.scoped_publication: A successful scoped current-app repair committed main-table evidence but did not republish the AppSwitcher and Home projections consumed by live surfaces.
root_cause.authoritative_removal: Current-app repair evidence did not distinguish a complete CG identity set from partial evidence, so disappeared windows could remain committed.
root_cause.home_retry: An incomplete empty selected-app detail projection was treated as a settled empty result instead of a retry signal.
root_cause.deferred_search: Search presentation could be requested while its committed index activation was pending, leaving the controller hidden after publication.
root_cause.zero_window_layout: An unchanged empty selected-app projection still published a session layout update, allowing a recursive zero-window transition loop.
root_cause.completed_cg_cleanup: Completed dirty CG identities used one cleanup rule across ordinary repair, activation verification, and explicit maintenance reasons.
root_cause.home_fixture_selection: XCTest reported a clipped Home app row as hittable, so the multi-app fixture could tap outside the visible scroll viewport and retain the prior selection.
root_cause.in_app_fixture_frontmost: The real in-app fixture launch declared a frontmost bundle intent, but no test consumer routed focused projection reads to that fixture process.

semantic_delta.scoped_publication: Every successful scoped repair republishes AppSwitcher and Home from the same committed read-model candidate.
semantic_delta.authoritative_removal: Authoritative CG identity evidence removes prior rows absent from that set; partial evidence preserves prior rows.
semantic_delta.home_retry: Incomplete empty Home detail reads signal an app-window change so the normal refresh path retries.
semantic_delta.deferred_search: Pending Search activation is retained until index publication, then activated and presented through the ordinary controller path.
semantic_delta.zero_window_layout: Unchanged empty selected-app candidates update context without publishing a new session layout.
semantic_delta.completed_cg_cleanup: Ordinary repair clears completed CG identities; activation verification keeps readback-mismatch identities stale until a barrier; explicit maintenance clears all.
semantic_delta.home_fixture_selection: Home fixture selection scrolls until the row is fully contained by its viewport and confirms the selected app through an expected window title.
semantic_delta.in_app_fixture_frontmost: Real-runtime UI tests may declare a fixture bundle whose focused read and refresh routing are resolved through an isolated TestingSupport decorator.
semantic_delta.tests: Seven additive behavior tests cover the new contracts; existing UI methods retain their visible oracles while using stable dynamic queries, bounded readiness, and shared AX-destroy, viewport-selection, and fixture-frontmost evidence. Two existing projection-consistency methods encode the explicitly confirmed degraded-context and incomplete-freshness contracts.

initial_c1_root_cause.service_identity: UI-test bootstrap installed a dedicated RuntimeProjectionService in AppDelegate test hooks while Home roots constructed their own default service.
initial_c1_root_cause.bootstrap_readiness: The bootstrap installed a service but returned before app-switcher maintenance, per-app window repair, and Search freshness publication completed.
initial_c1_root_cause.fixture_main_table: The UI-test dataset marked every PID as collected but seeded no WindowRecord identities, so trusted mock windows could not reach main-table projections.
initial_c1_root_cause.nested_repair: The ordinary drain evaluated ready requests once. A Space repair created inside an app repair remained pending while the Search barrier stayed uncommitted.
initial_c1_root_cause.home_transient_read: A transient missing Home detail was treated as app removal and discarded the last committed summary and windows.
initial_c1_root_cause.search_auto_entry: Automatic window-layer entry could change the session mode while launch-requested Search waited for its committed index, preventing deferred Search activation.
